name: Max Udovichenko
intro: I am a third-year Music Technology student at Kingston University London, composing original music and designing sound for games and films. My work spans ambient scoring, sound design, and 5.1 composition.
philosophy: I build emotional worlds through texture, rhythm, and space. Every project starts with narrative, then becomes sound.

timeline.title: Kingston University London
timeline.description: BA (Hons) Music Technology. Focus on synthesis, sequencing, and interactive audio systems.

timeline.title: Film and Game Collaboration
timeline.description: Scored student films and designed game audio environments for independent creators.

timeline.title: Spatial Mixing Development
timeline.description: Expanded multichannel practice through 5.1 composition and analog studio workflows.

timeline.title: Graduation Target
timeline.description: Expected completion of BA (Hons) with portfolio centered on narrative music and interactive sound design.
